title: The Sound of a Black Hole

scenes.text: Black holes are silent. Space carries no air for sound.
scenes.art_prompt: a colossal nebula in deep space, towering pillars of gas, stars, awe-inspiring wide shot

scenes.text: But the gas around them is not silent.
scenes.art_prompt: a planet's rings seen from close orbit, sharp sunlight, detailed surface below

scenes.text: It ripples in pressure waves you could hear if your ears were light years wide.
scenes.art_prompt: a black hole warping starlight, accretion disk, gravitational lensing, cinematic

scenes.text: One of them hums fifty-seven octaves below middle C.
scenes.art_prompt: countless galaxies scattered across the void, tiny foreground spacecraft for scale

scenes.text: It has been humming the same note for two billion years.
scenes.art_prompt: a supernova blooming among the stars, brilliant expanding light
Earth small and blue against an enormous dark cosmos, quiet final wide shot
